issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning a String, but the intended implementation (solution) and the natural interpretation of the task use an int return type. This inconsistency between the problem statement UML and the solution/template will confuse students about the expected return type and may cause them to implement the method incorrectly (as String) or to be uncertain which type to use.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferably update the UML and problem statement to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (and update any textual references to indicate it returns an integer), or alternatively change the template/solution to return String. The recommended fix is to change the UML in problem_statement.md from String to int so it matches the intended implementation and tests.
